answer: We design a Sybil-resistant mechanism embedding zero-knowledge verifiable delay and dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, forcing each identity vine to hold deep staking collateral. Subgame-perfect slashing penalties that liquidate capital on equivocation form a rigid barrier, making identity multiplication's expected utility strictly negative to deter sybil lantern deployment. This design compels rational agents to mirror canonical strategies, ensuring robust Nash equilibrium against dominated utility deviations.
